description: This file manages WebSocket gateway connections, event handling, and state management for a web-based control UI, including reconnection logic, event processing, and snapshot application.

classes.name: GatewayHost
classes.description: Represents the state and configuration of a gateway connection, including session info, event logs, and connection status.

classes.name: SessionDefaultsSnapshot
classes.description: Stores default session configuration options such as default agent ID and session keys.

classes.name: GatewayHostWithShutdownMessage
classes.description: Extends GatewayHost with optional shutdown message and reconnect behavior flags.

methods.name: resolveControlUiClientVersion
methods.description: Determines the client version string for the control UI based on gateway URL, server version, and page URL.

methods.name: normalizeSessionKeyForDefaults
methods.description: Normalizes session key strings considering default session configurations and aliases.

methods.name: applySessionDefaults
methods.description: Applies default session settings to a gateway host, updating session keys and settings accordingly.

methods.name: connectGateway
methods.description: Establishes and manages a WebSocket connection to the gateway, handling reconnection, event subscriptions, and state resets.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Dispatches incoming gateway events to appropriate handlers with error catching.

methods.name: handleTerminalChatEvent
methods.description: Handles final or error chat events, resetting tool streams and optionally reloading chat history.

methods.name: handleChatGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes chat-related gateway events, updating session activity and chat history as needed.

methods.name: handleGatewayEventUnsafe
methods.description: Processes individual gateway events, updating logs, handling specific event types, and managing connection state.

methods.name: applySnapshot
methods.description: Applies a snapshot of state from the gateway hello message to the host, updating presence, health, and session defaults.
